post.title: Bathroom Remodel Renton WA — Permits, Asbestos Checks, Ventilation, Waterproofing and Hiring
post.description: A Renton bathroom remodel guide: when the City's Residential Interior Remodel permit applies, separate plumbing, electrical and mechanical permits, asbestos surveys, review times, inspections and hiring.

notes: Box-authored catch-up for the missed 2026-11-25 run (built 2026-11-26 early morning). Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox not readable at the usual path (see intake); no 2026-11-25 board post packet used. Topic: bathroom remodel in Renton WA (King County). Sources read 2026-11-26: City of Renton Residential Interior Remodels page (asbestos survey first per PSCAA/L&I; King County Environmental Health approval for septic properties adding a bath or bedroom; submittal plan contents incl. fixture/fan/vent locations, wall section, stamped plans for structural changes, WSEC-R checklist; separate electrical/plumbing/mechanical/fire permits; OTC permits in portal typically same day; electronic submittal, 5 days intake review; residential first review 2-3 weeks, revisions 1-2 weeks); Renton Building Permits FAQ (RMC 4-5-060E.1 quote, 105.2 exemptions, no expedite, no Basics program, no work before permit, fee estimator, construction hours, DIY electrical 3-year residency, no combined permits, IVR 425-430-7202 / CASSP inspections, no call-ahead, virtual meetings, no CO for single family, WA contractor license + Renton business license before permit, 425-430-7215, City Hall 1055 South Grady Way); Renton COR Maps; Online Permit Portal Help; Renton Housing Repair Assistance Program; PSCAA asbestos; L&I asbestos certification (AHERA good-faith inspection); EPA RRP; King County Environmental Health permits; King County C&D materials; SBCC energy code; Energy Star ventilation fans; PSE rebates; L&I Verify + hiring a contractor.
